name: Elegant Marbles and Grani Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Elegant Marble and Grani Industries is engaged in manufacturing & trading of marble, granites & other stones tiles & slabs.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:
A) Stones:[1]
Company has an online collection of 800+ natural stone materials viz., 
Artico, Confusion Dark, Galactico Onyx, Breccia Oniciata, Lilac Super Extra, Scabas, Van Gogh, Armani, etc. classified as:
a) Italian & Exotic Marble[2]
b) Precious Gemstones[3]
c) Onyx and Crystal Onyx[4]
d) Travertine[5]
e) Granite[6]
B) Surfaces:[7]
Company has a selection of designer tiles and engineered surfaces for decorative interiors and exterior applications viz.,
a) Designer Tiles[8]
b) Glass 2[9]
c) Natural Stone Mosaic[10]
d) Terrazzo Engineered Marble[11]
e) Quartz Surfaces[12]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.45 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.95.0 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.65.8 Cr.
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.0%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 3.62% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.34 Cr.
